name: Contact Lens Chronicles
description: Soft, rigid, scleral, hybrid, ortho-K, and specialty lenses — topography, sagittal fitting, centration, complications, and managing the unhappy CL patient.

episodes.title: Contact Lens Materials: From HEMA to Silicone Hydrogel
episodes.description: How Dk, water content, and modulus shape oxygen transmission, comfort, and corneal health.

episodes.title: Soft Lens Designs: Spherical, Toric, and Multifocal
episodes.description: Matching the design to the prescription, the stabilizing prism in torics, and the multifocal concentric logic.

episodes.title: Corneal Topography for CL Fitting: Reading the Map
episodes.description: Axial and sagittal maps, the bowtie pattern, and what the topography tells you before the trial lens.

episodes.title: Sagittal Height Fitting: The SAG Revolution
episodes.description: Why sagittal fitting beats base curve for soft lenses and how SAG guides scleral lens selection.

episodes.title: Soft Toric Fitting: Rotation, Stability, and the LARS Rule
episodes.description: Reading rotation, adjusting axis with LARS, and the lens designs that stabilize best.

episodes.title: Multifocal CL: Simultaneous Versus Translating Vision
episodes.description: The center-near and center-distance designs, the add placement, and the pupil dependence.

episodes.title: Modified Monovision: The Compromise That Works
episodes.description: When to blend a distance lens with a multifocal, the dominance choice, and the adaptation period.

episodes.title: Rigid Gas Permeable Lenses: The Clarity Advantage
episodes.description: Why RGPs outperform soft lenses on irregular corneas, the fitting philosophy, and the adaptation curve.

episodes.title: RGP Fitting: Base Curve, Tear Lens, and Fluorescein Patterns
episodes.description: Reading the fluorescein pooling and bearing, the tear lens power, and the alignment goal.

episodes.title: Scleral Lenses: Vaulting the Cornea
episodes.description: The scleral fitting revolution — sagittal depth, limbal clearance, and landing zone alignment.

episodes.title: Scleral Lens Fitting: The Trial Lens Method
episodes.description: Choosing initial sag, assessing vault after settling, and managing midday fogging.

episodes.title: Hybrid Lenses: The RGP Center with a Soft Skirt
episodes.description: The patient profile, the fitting approach, and the limitations that keep them a niche option.

episodes.title: Orthokeratology: Reshaping the Cornea Overnight
episodes.description: The reverse geometry lens, the myopia control evidence, and the candidacy criteria that define success.

episodes.title: Ortho-K Fitting: Topography, Sag, and the Treatment Zone
episodes.description: Reading the bullseye topography, adjusting the return zone, and the centration that matters.

episodes.title: Myopia Control with CLs: The Evidence Base
episodes.description: The defocus theory, the dual-focus designs, and the informed consent conversation with parents.
